text:
incident-bot: Pager: p99 decode latency spike (>5s) detected for model redwood-7b-quant in us-west-2. SLO alert fired (streaming stalls observed). Affected routes: /v1/generate streaming. start_ts=1791234567

maya: I'm on it. seeing p95 ~1.2s but p99 jumping to 5-8s on several nodes. streaming stalls + socket timeouts from clients.

raj: adding context — we rolled forward new compile flags and TRT/FlashAttention libs in the build from 2026-02-17. suspecting decode kernel variant selection regression.

chris: Confirmed. kernel-logs show repeated fallback to slow path for attention kernels. grep from runtime box:```
[2026-03-01T15:12:03Z] WARN kernel_selector: kernel_variant mismatch for layer 9, falling back to scalar_attention
[2026-03-01T15:12:04Z] WARN decode: cache miss for kv cache on node gpu-12
```

sara: Are we seeing memory paging/ooms? metrics show occasional soft page thrashing on gpu-12 but not full OOMs. paging counters spike when sequence length > 1024.

maya: Customer reports: two large streaming customers saw stalled streams and reconnection loops for ~2-10 minutes. Sales/CS notified?

pm-ellen: Sales notified for the affected customers (acct IDs: acct_34, acct_77). We're prepping an impact note for customers. Please add ETA for fix.

raj: quick triage steps I'm running: 1) push runtime config to prefer legacy kernel path (fast fallback) 2) scale up older build nodes pool and route traffic 3) disable new TRT flashattn variant via runtime flag.

dave: How do we flip the runtime flag safely?

raj: command to flip on control-plane (one-liner):```bash
curl -X POST "https://control-plane.internal/api/v1/runtime/flags" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"flag":"prefer_legacy_attention","value":true}'
```
I'll apply with canary to 10% first.

ops-bot: deploy-bot started canary rollout 10% for flag prefer_legacy_attention at 1791234580.

maya: Canary metrics looking good so far — p99 down from 6.8s -> 1.9s on canary hosts, streaming stalls drop. rolling to 50%.

chris: Observed additional symptom: newer TRT binary triggers a different kernel selection at runtime leading to increased kernel compile cache misses. Workaround: force reuse of precompiled kernels by setting KERNEL_CACHE_POLICY=warm_start. I'll push that env to the affected pool too.

sara: Note: warm_start reduces tail slightly but doesn't fully resolve when seqlen spike. we should keep both mitigations: prefer_legacy_attention + warm_start.

maya: rolling both mitigations to 100% now.

ops-bot: deploy-bot finished rollout to 100% at 1791234605.

maya: p99 stabilized to ~1.3s across cluster, p95 unchanged. No more streaming stalls reported in last 6m.

pm-ellen: Sending preliminary incident message to customers: short note + ETA for permanent fix? Suggest ETA 24h for rollback in release pipeline or full revert of the compile change.

raj: next steps: 1) revert compile-flag change in the nightly build (flag: use_trt_attn_v2=false) 2) run targeted repro on CI with seqlen 2048 and perf harness to validate 8.6 flashattn interactions 3) schedule canary for new TRT/FlashAttn after fixes.

chris: I'll open a runtime PR with conservative kernel selection heuristics and add a guard for kernel compile cache warm_start. reference:```diff
- kernel_selector: prefer new_variants if perf_estimate < 1.2
+ kernel_selector: prefer new_variants only if perf_estimate < 0.95 and kernel_cache_warmed
```

maya: Action owners: raj -> revert control-plane release + coord with infra to drain suspect nodes, chris -> runtime PR + perf tests, sara -> collect detailed metrics per-customer and replay traces, dave -> prepare postmortem template and customer impact draft, pm-ellen -> coordinate customer comms.

ops-bot: incident-bot acknowledged. incident severity: Sev2. incident channel created: #incident-1791234567-runtime-decode.

maya: handoff to overnight oncall (dave) in 15m. if any regression reappears, escalate to eng-runtime.

dave: taking handoff. I have the runbook and the mitigation commands. I will monitor p99 for 1h and hold pager.

raj: docs/notes — likely root cause: new TRT/FlashAttention variant caused kernel selection to prefer a kernel path that triggers runtime compile/cache misses and occasional device-level paging under heavy seqlen, leading to streaming stalls and p99 tail spikes.

chris: long term fixes: improve kernel cache persistence, add perf regression gate in CI for TRT/FlashAttn upgrades, and add a model-level config to pin attention implementation.

pm-ellen: I'll update customers with a timeline: 1) short-term mitigations applied (done) 2) revert compile flag in nightly (in progress) 3) full fix and validation (24-48h) 4) postmortem and RCA (72h).

dave: adding note to incident doc, will follow up with links to logs and the runtime PR when open. Leaving watchgroup for overnight: @raj @chris @sara @maya.

maya: thanks team. closing active pager for now but keeping thread open for follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
